contentList.content: Held fast, and made to dance regardless. The body obeys the spell rather than its owner: Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws fail automatically, and attacks made from nearby always land as Critical Hits.
Bind a humanoid in place and set them dancing. They are Incapacitated and cannot move, and nearby attackers strike with certainty. A successful Wisdom Saving Throw at the end of each turn ends it.
